name: Gasthaus Tiroler Weinstube
beschreibung:
Centrally situated in the resort town of Seefeld in Tirol, the Tiroler Weinstube offers alpine comfort and delicious Tyrolean dining. Well-kept rooms create a welcoming ambiance.

Seefeld mountain cable cars, Olympic cross-country ski trails, and walking routes are easily reached on foot.
kurzbeschreibung: Gasthaus Tiroler Weinstube in Seefeld provides cosy accommodations and rich culinary traditions on the plateau.
